summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Long Pond Real Estate Select ETF (LPRE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in real estate equity. The fund is an actively managed fund that invests in real estate companies from around the globe the sub-adviser believes are capable of compounding value over time and through different market cycles. LPRE was launched on Apr 4, 2025 and is issued by Long Pond.

holdings.infoBox: LPRE is an equity ETF with a total of 24 individual holdings. The top holdings are Hyatt Hotels stock at 8.02%, Independence Realty Trust at 7.92%, D.R. Horton at 7.85%, Equity LifeStyle Properties at 7.82%, and UDR, Inc. at 6.46%.
